items.title: P&G Fiscal 2027 Outlook Brings an 8% Core EPS Headwind Into Focus
items.summary: PG faces an 8% fiscal 2027 core EPS headwind from higher input costs, financing expense, lower non-operating income and currency pressures.

items.summary: PG enters fiscal 2027 with modest growth and a valuation premium, as productivity, innovation and robust cash returns support its investment case.

items.title: Oil jumps, Fed hawkish, Jobs data - What’s moving markets
items.summary: Investing.com - U.S. stock futures fell early Monday as renewed U.S.-Iran fighting pushed oil prices higher and added another layer of uncertainty for investors.

items.title: China’s massive oil reserves give Beijing leverage during Iran war
items.summary: Investing.com -- China’s vast oil stockpiles have allowed Beijing to slash crude imports during the Iran war, helping contain global oil prices and reducing its vulnerability to supply disruptions, The Wall Street Journal reported Friday.

items.title: Trump says U.S. secures control of over 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan oil
items.summary: Investing.com -- President Donald Trump said Friday that the United States has reached an agreement with Venezuela giving it majority control over more than 65 billion barrels of the country’s proven oil reserves, in what he described as the biggest oil deal in history.

items.title: US in talks to acquire major stake in Venezuelan oil fields, Bloomberg reports
items.summary: Investing.com -- The U.S. government is actively negotiating with Venezuela to acquire a major stake in the nation’s energy reserves, potentially signaling a radical shift in Western Hemisphere energy policy, according to a report from Bloomberg. The ongoing discussions between officials from both nations include a potential 100-year lease on multiple Venezuelan oil fields, though negotiators emphasize that terms remain fluid and subject to change. items.title: Bessent announces campaign to cut Iran from global economy; Tehran vows response
items.summary: Investing.com -- Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced Monday that the United States is launching a campaign to isolate Iran from the global economy, warning that any country conducting business with Iran risks facing U.S. sanctions.
